_about: Methanol (1) + n-Heptane (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 85.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Alinejhad, Mehran, Shariati, Alireza, Hekayati, Javad, Experimental Vapor-Liquid Equilibria and Thermodynamic Modeling of the Methanol + n-Heptane and 1-Butanol + Aniline Binary Systems, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 965-971
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5, 6. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.09 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
